options.description: The options obs-document --adapter-option NAME=VALUE may pass. A boolean option is passed as --NAME when its value is true and left out when it is false. A vault-file option's VALUE is ID=PATH, PATH relative to the vault; the core passes --NAME ID=<the resolved file> (spec/design_input/cli.md, Adapter options).

repeats.description: Whether --adapter-option may give this option more than once; a single-valued option given twice fails the call (spec/design_input/cli.md, Adapter options).
